verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a consumer AI agent that stores user data in a hosted VM. The evidence never mentions letting users choose a region or residency. The closest items cover adjacent data controls: a training opt-out, VM file download and backups, and a Forget skill. None of these let a user pick where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
